subject: thm-qa-18-reversible-search-cost
summary: F2 omitted the one-state convention: its maximum over nonstationary eigenvalues is undefined for P=[1], whereas the declared restriction norm is zero and the gap is 1. Added that case explicitly and restricted the maximum formula to ergodic chains with at least two states. This is nonfatal because proof 1.1 only needs the bound on each nonstationary eigenvalue, which is vacuous for one state; steps 6.1 and 7.1 still cover empty and fully marked one-state inputs.
